title: Freeze complete Meta POST authority-path design for B02 before replacement

supersedes.reason: 15G mixed incomplete implementation with design and required two corrective commits (pre-PG gate, location_id propagation). 15G2 freezes the audited design; a bounded replacement slice implements it cleanly from master.

out_of_scope: any runtime behavior change on master paths
deploy / cloud / database / Stripe / production WhatsApp operations
live Meta / WhatsApp / DB / network calls

current_master_posture.shadow: tenant_channel_shadow observe-only; does not override live client_slug
current_master_posture.pg_acquisition: handleMetaWhatsAppWebhookPost always calls withPgClient after normalize on valid JSON

renames.reason: guest_message_events table missing does not stop other reads/writes (staff lookup, owner, open-demo, draft/send)

enforcement_order: if blocked → build authority-blocked HTTP envelope; acquired_pg=false; return effective normalized + blocked response (zero withPgClient / persistence / draft / send / owner / demo)
else → withPgClient(pg => processMetaWhatsAppWebhookInbound({ pg, env, body, normalized, signatureMeta })); return effective post-authority normalized for HTTP audit + response
shared_authority_owner.why_shared: Every post-normalize branch (guest persist/send, terminal no-draft/send, owner Command Center, open demo + validation failure, guest-message-event-table-unavailable continuation, processed replay, unprocessed duplicate/conflict continuation, blocked phone gate, PG/downstream errors) is reached only after the same Staff API POST entry acquires PG today. Authority must gate that single choke point before pool/client acquisition so blocked identities cannot touch any branch. The entry must return the effective normalized identity so HTTP audit does not log a stale pre-authority snapshot.

owner_read_scope_decision.basis: lookupStaffPhoneAccess and owner SQL filter only on client_slug; no location_id predicate on staff allowlist or owner-read SQL
owner_read_scope_decision.replacement_implication: Authoritative client_slug drives owner lookup/query/send/storage/replay. Propagate location_id into stored normalized + idempotency when present, without inventing location-scoped owner reads.

surfaces: buildMetaInboundIdempotencyKey (location-scoped when location_id present; legacy shape when absent)
owner lookupStaffPhoneAccess + owner SQL query (tenant-wide by client_slug)
owner Command Center send body + stored normalized + owner replay
open-demo request body + execute path (must not hardcode conflicting wolfhouse-somo when authority active)
both guest_message_events table_missing entry points (find + insert)
authoritative_identity_propagation_requi.registry_note: Resolver registry client_slug for Wolfhouse is 'wolfhouse' with location_id 'wolfhouse-somo'; legacy DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG remains 'wolfhouse-somo'. Replacement must treat resolver client_slug+location_id as authoritative when policy active, and document alias risk.

replacement_implementation_slice.basis: implement from clean master using 15G2 frozen design; do not cherry-pick deferred 15G branch
bounded_scope: Introduce processMetaWhatsAppWebhookPostEntry; wire handleMetaWhatsAppWebhookPost to it
Apply authority after normalize; block before withPgClient
Return effective post-authority normalized from PostEntry for HTTP audit
Propagate trusted location_id through draft/send/idempotency builders
Prove post-authority identity on all enumerated post-normalize surfaces
Offline RED/GREEN verifier proving zero PG on block + location propagation on known enabled path
15H overlay; leave 15A historical B02 vulnerable until live activation
explicitly_excluded_from_15h: open-demo booking-write / Stripe / Graph API enablement
changing owner-read scope from tenant-wide to location-scoped

must_pass: enabled+routing+known phone_number_id → live client_slug+location_id authoritative through persistence seed, draft input, send body, idempotency key, response.normalized
enabled+routing+unknown|missing|ambiguous|conflicting → authority-blocked response with acquired_pg=false and zero withPgClient/persistence/draft/send/owner/demo calls
default-off → exact current shadow-only master behavior (legacy client_slug, no hard block, PG still acquired as today)
enabled+routing-absent → inactive shadow-only preserved (no hard block)
legacy idempotency key unchanged when location_id absent
PostEntry returns effective post-authority normalized; HTTP audit uses that identity (not a stale pre-authority snapshot)
post-authority identity at owner lookup (tenant-wide client_slug), owner SQL query, owner send body, owner storage, and owner replay
post-authority identity at open-demo request body and open-demo execution path; no conflicting hardcoded wolfhouse-somo when authority active
post-authority identity at replay lookup key and replay response
post-authority identity on both guest_message_events table_missing entry points (find + insert → processWithoutPersistence)
post-authority identity on terminal no-draft/send (unsupported/empty text) response.normalized
post-authority identity on open-demo validation-failure envelope and documented PG/downstream error handling posture
owner reads remain tenant-wide (client_slug); location_id propagates to storage/idempotency without inventing location-scoped owner reads
no deploy config edits; activation remains default-off
must_not: enable policy on any runtime in-slice
acquire PG before authority decision when policy active+blocked
trust body/options client_slug over resolver when authority active
leave location_id only in tenant_channel_shadow when authority active+known
treat guest_message_events table_missing as stopping all other reads/writes
audit HTTP with pre-authority normalized when PostEntry produced an effective post-authority identity
silently change owner-read scope to location-scoped owner reads

residual_risk.summary: Until 15H lands and an operator separately activates routing+authority, live B02 remains vulnerable (shadow-only; default wolfhouse-somo live slug). Deferred 15G must not be treated as mergeable remediation.
